svg.title: RAG tuning changes move multiple metrics
svg.desc: Four concise before and after tuning examples show K increase, reranking, ANN search effort, and metadata filtering can affect precision, recall, latency, and cost. Effects are examples to evaluate rather than guarantees.
svg.text: One retrieval change can improve one metric and worsen another
Illustrative outcomes only—measure on your golden set and production slices.
More relevant material found, much more noise returned.
Reorders candidates; cannot recover chunks below Top-K.
Compare recall improvement with p95 latency and cost.
Recall can ↓ if the filter excludes valid evidence
Review filter coverage, document metadata quality, and ACL effects.
Tune one component at a time where possible; capture configuration, metrics, latency, cost, and error cases in the trace.
